title: Cinematic Mirror Portal
description: A woman in a flowing blue starry cape stands in an ornate old theater, reaching through a large cracked golden mirror. Her black-and-white reflection smiles back as glowing film reels and movie tickets float around them in a swirl of magical light. The theater floor is covered with scattered film strips under a starry painted ceiling.
prompt: A woman wearing an elegant blue starry cape stands inside a grand vintage theater with red velvet seats and painted dome ceiling, reaching her hand through a large cracked golden mirror frame. Her monochrome reflection inside the mirror is smiling and touching her hand. Swirling magical energy, glowing film reels, and vintage movie tickets float around them. Cinematic lighting with dramatic spotlight from above, scattered film strips on the floor, mystical and nostalgic atmosphere.
